title: Movix v2.1.4 - Accurate Movie Audio Languages & Direct OTA
changelog: Strict Movie Language Filtering: Only genuinely available audio tracks for each movie are shown; unavailable dummy languages completely removed
Accurate Audio Track Selection: Audio language dynamically reflects the movie original soundtrack and verified dubbed releases
Instant In-App Direct OTA Updates: One-tap background package download & installation
100% Zero-Overlay Cinema Playback: All options, controls, and pills are completely hidden while movie plays
Instant Tap-to-Summon: Screen tap seamlessly restores Language, Options, Quality, and Volume controls
True Edge-to-Edge Fullscreen Playback: Adaptive display cutout support across notch, punch-hole, and curved displays
Universal Aspect Ratio Fill: 1-tap zoom/crop to fill modern 19.5:9 and 20:9 phone displays with zero letterboxing
Live Daily Netflix TMDB Trends: Continuously updated real-time trending movies
